summary: Frontend regression + new-feature smoke test for MaîtrAgenda Settings rework (DB export/import + copyright). All testIDs render, theme picker works, copyright text matches spec, mail link does not crash, dashboard/agenda/tasks regress cleanly, no red screen, and removed CategoryChip/PriorityBadge components have no remaining imports. Export download was successfully triggered (blob file 'maitragenda_2026-05-05_19h08.json' captured). Import/Reset confirmation flows could NOT be asserted via DOM in the web test runner because react-native-web's Alert.alert maps to native window.confirm/window.alert (browser-native dialogs that are not part of the DOM). Code path appears correct; needs validation on a real iOS/Android device. No blocking issues found.

integration_issues.flow: Import alert chain (Annuler / Fusionner / Tout remplacer)
integration_issues.issue: On react-native-web, Alert.alert with >2 buttons uses native browser dialogs (window.alert/confirm) which are NOT part of DOM, so the 3-button alert chain cannot be asserted in headless web tests. On web, browsers also typically reduce 3-button alerts to confirm-style 2-button dialogs. Behavior should be re-verified on an actual native device. Code in settings.tsx#chooseImportMode is structurally correct.

Same react-native-web limitation: confirmReset Alert.alert isn't visible in DOM during web test. Reset button correctly toggles disabled state based on data presence (verified). Confirm dialog text could not be asserted automatically.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: "text-subject" is not a valid icon name for family material-community. Repeats multiple times when opening the new-event form. Cosmetic only — does not break flow.

action_items: Manually verify import/reset Alert.alert chains on a real iOS/Android device (web runtime cannot fully render multi-button Alert.alert).

Replace the invalid material-community icon name 'text-subject' (likely in the event creation form / category icons) with a valid one such as 'text-box-outline' or 'note-text-outline' to silence repeating warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx is well structured (~450 lines, fine). Uses StyleSheet.create, View/Text/Pressable correctly, all interactive elements have testID.
backup.ts cleanly separates web (Blob+a.click download) from native (FileSystem+Sharing) paths, validates payload shape via isValidPayload, and supports merge/replace deduped by id — looks solid.
Copyright section uses hyphens '—' as requested and the mail Pressable has hitSlop=8 for accessibility.
No leftover imports of CategoryChip/PriorityBadge anywhere in the codebase (grep confirms).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on assertable items (10/10): copyright, email, theme switch, all testIDs visible, initial disabled states, post-event export-enabled state, export download triggered, mail click no-crash, dashboard renders, agenda renders, tasks renders, no red screen

seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_Event via FAB → category → save during the run to enable export-data button. Reset confirm was opened but cancelled, so the event remains in localStorage for next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web environment leaves 1 event 'TEST_Event' in localStorage (key @maitragenda/events/v1) so export-data is already enabled. To test fresh disabled state, clear storage or use a fresh browser context. react-native-web alerts (Alert.alert) are native browser dialogs and cannot be asserted via document.body.innerText — capture them via page.on('dialog') handler instead, e.g. page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) and check the dialog.message value. Public app URL: https://ecole-planning-pro.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no functional bug found. Limitations encountered are environmental (react-native-web Alert.alert is mapped to browser-native window.alert/confirm; DocumentPicker on web opens an OS-level file picker that headless Playwright cannot drive).
